data.title: Senior Advanced Project Engineer - Electronics Supplier Development
data.description:
As a Senior Advanced Project Engineer – Electronics Supplier Development for the Electronics Value Stream, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of electronic suppliers. You will be responsible for developing strategic partnerships with suppliers, managing their performance, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and supply chain efficiency.

You will report directly to our Director of Supplier Development, and you’ll work remotely in the US. Our preferred candidate will reside in the Northeast region.

In this role, you will impact our supplier development by bringing your extensive expertise and experience to our organization. You will play a critical role in driving supplier performance and ensuring that our suppliers meet the highest quality standards. Your contributions directly impact our organization's operational excellence and overall success.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Supplier Capability Assessment: Evaluate the capabilities of electronic component suppliers and support the transition of hardware from development to production.
  • Quality Improvement Plans: Conduct supplier risk assessments and implement targeted quality improvement plans specific to electronic component manufacturing processes.
  • Performance Management: Lead and participate in capacity assessment exercises, driving supplier performance by establishing clear metrics and performance expectations related to electronic components.
  • Operational Excellence: Partner with Suppliers to Lead and support OPEX projects enabling improvements in product flow / throughput, lead time reduction, & yield.
  • Regulatory Compliance: Ensure that electronic component suppliers comply with quality management systems, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborative Engagement: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering – New Product Introduction, manufacturing, and quality assurance, to resolve supplier-related issues and improve overall supply chain performance.
  • Travel local & domestically 25% normally, and up to 50% (on rare occasion).

data.description:
Senior Data Center Network/ Mellanox Engineer Location: Remote, United States Schedule: Participation in a 24x7 operational support model with weekend coverage required Need to be strong in: BGP EVPN/VXLAN, Troubleshooting, Firewall, Automation (ansible/python). Overview Simple Solutions searching for Senior Ethernet Network Engineers to support large-scale AI and high-performance computing (HPC) data center deployments. This role will focus on deploying, validating, troubleshooting, and operationalizing complex Ethernet fabrics supporting GPU compute clusters. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in modern data center networking, automation, Linux administration, and large-scale leaf-spine architectures. This position offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI infrastructure projects while partnering with engineering teams, customers, and data center operations personnel to deliver reliable and repeatable deployments. Responsibilities Perform cluster bring-up activities using approved deployment methodologies, automation workflows, and configuration standards. Design and validate large-scale Ethernet fabrics utilizing CLOS and leaf-spine architectures. Develop IP addressing plans and validate network topology, connectivity documentation, and infrastructure designs. Build, provision, test, and validate network switch configurations in lab and production environments. Configure and troubleshoot inter-node networking, including RoCE-enabled environments. Develop automation scripts and tooling using Python and Ansible. Troubleshoot network, hardware, cabling, and configuration issues during deployment and operational support activities. Partner with data center technicians and remote-hands teams to coordinate remediation efforts. Document incidents, troubleshooting findings, root cause analysis, and deployment outcomes. Create deployment records, configuration artifacts, validation reports, and operational handoff documentation. Communicate project status, risks, blockers, and technical updates to stakeholders and cross-functional teams. Required Qualifications 7+ years of experience with Ethernet switching, routing, and TCP/IP networking. Expert-level experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting data center leaf-spine/CLOS architectures. 4+ years of hands-on experience with: BGP EVPN VXLAN 3+ years of Linux systems administration experience. 2+ years of Python and Ansible automation experience. Experience with ZTP, PXE, and DHCP-based provisioning technologies. Experience supporting customer-facing engagements in professional services, consulting, or technical support environments. Experience leveraging AI-assisted tools for technical operations and automation development. Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently in a remote, shift-based support environment. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with Cumulus Linux. Experience deploying and supporting AI GPU clusters or HPC environments. Experience with RoCE networking and high-performance interconnect technologies. Experience diagnosing physical-layer and cabling issues within data center environments. Previous experience serving as a technical lead, shift lead, or mentor to engineering teams. Technical Skills Ethernet Switching & Routing TCP/IP Networking Data Center Networking CLOS / Leaf-Spine Architectures BGP EVPN VXLAN RoCE Cumulus Linux Linux Administration Python Ansible Network Automation ZTP PXE DHCP AI Infrastructure GPU Clusters HPC Environments Deployment & Operational Support

data.description:
Structural Designer

Remote | Hybrid option: Melbourne, FL, Ellicott City, MD, or Pittsburgh, PA

Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000

The Role

Above Group is looking for a Structural Designer to join our Structural Engineering team and help carry projects from concept through construction. Reporting to a Senior Structural Engineer, you will be responsible for the structural design of the projects you are assigned, producing CAD drawings and calculations and turning an engineer’s vision into clear, buildable documents. Your work will directly reflect the quality and vision of our company standards.

This is a hands-on role with room to grow. You will collaborate closely with engineers and project managers, visit active job sites to see how your designs come together, and support construction-phase work such as shop drawing reviews and RFIs. We rely on designers who work well both independently and as part of a team, communicate clearly, and are committed to excellence in everything they produce.

What You’ll Do

  • Create CAD drawings and calculations under the direction of structural engineers, and carry out the structural design of all projects to which you are assigned
  • Develop and implement design criteria and system designs from concept to construction, in line with company procedures, regulations, and client standards
  • Work alongside engineers to understand their vision and translate it into drawings and designs; support them with specific design tasks, markups, and review comments
  • Interpret Basis of Design (BOD) documents, field surveys, and code research; author BOD narratives and design criteria documents and edit design specifications
  • Coordinate with team members and other disciplines on the layout of structural systems and equipment locations
  • Review shop drawing submittals and respond to RFIs, submittals, and other construction-phase services tasks
  • Travel to job sites to gain a full picture of project conditions and construction progress
  • Attend weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly project meetings, as well as meetings with other departments, and keep engineering leads and project managers informed on timelines and deadlines
  • Incorporate feedback from project managers to deliver top-quality products for clients
  • Maintain current knowledge of codes, standards, and local regulations

What you Bring to the Role

  • Minimum of 3 years of related experience (or an equivalent combination of education and experience)
  • Associate’s degree in computer drafting and design or a related field, preferred
  • Proficient in structural concepts including connection design, design loads, lateral systems, different materials, and foundation design
  • Proficient in AutoCAD and Revit
  • Proficient in Bluebeam and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel)
  • Knowledge of the functionality of 3D imaging cameras
  • Excellent written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills; strong writing for BOD narratives, design criteria, specifications, and RFI responses; able to interface effectively with senior management
  • Strong work ethic; able to work independently/self-motivated, as well as in a collaborative team setting, highly organized, and detail oriented
  • Strong project management, strategic planning, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to multi-task
  • Strong time management with flexibility to adapt to changing schedules and duties
  • High levels of confidentiality, integrity, and dependability
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% for site visits and client meetings
  • U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident of the U.S.

Nice to have: Experience with structural design tools such as STAAD, TEDDS, or RAM Structural System.

Why Above Group

We are a faith-based AEC firm built around a simple idea: continuously improving the built environment for the glory of God. Our mission is to demonstrate the love of Jesus Christ by empowering excellent AEC professionals to provide superior service. Four values guide how we work: Christian Values, Uncompromising Quality, Buffalo (running toward challenges rather than away from them), and Extreme Team. If that resonates with you, you will fit here.

Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability coverage, employer-funded HSA contributions, and an annual profit-sharing bonus tied to the company’s collective results.

Remote Work Requirements

This role is fully remote or a hybrid option for candidates residing near Melbourne, FL, Ellicott City, MD, or Pittsburgh, PA. Any type of remote work requires reliable high-speed internet capable of supporting video conferencing, VPN, and cloud applications; a secure home network appropriate for confidential company and client information; and a dedicated, quiet workspace suitable for sustained focus and professional video meetings.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

About us

Chronosphere, a Palo Alto Networks company, is the observability platform built for control in the modern, containerized world. Chronosphere empowers customers to focus on the data and insights that matter by reducing complexity, optimizing costs, and remediating issues faster. Chronosphere reduces data volumes and associated costs by 84% on average while saving developers thousands of hours. Recognized as a leader by major analyst firms, Chronosphere is trusted by the world's most innovative brands, including DoorDash, Affirm, and Zillow.


About our roles

We are building AI Observability and Evaluation capabilities on Chronosphere’s observability platform to help developers understand and improve the accuracy, relevance, performance, and safety of AI models, agents, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications. Our team enables customers to systematically test, measure, and benchmark AI agents and applications before deployment and monitor how they behave in production. We turn complex telemetry and evaluation data into insights that help developers build and operate reliable AI agents and applications at scale.

We are looking for experienced engineers with a strong product sense who asks “why” as often as “how”. You’ll partner with product managers, engineers, and customers to translate emerging AI observability and evaluation needs into scalable backend systems and cohesive developer workflows. You’ll help shape the technical roadmap and architecture, taking features from early exploration through production delivery.

Qualifications

You will

  • Build backend capabilities that help developers observe and evaluate AI models, agents, and RAG applications before and during production
  • Design systems for systematic testing, measurement, and benchmarking of AI agents and applications accuracy, relevance, performance, and safety
  • Build scalable APIs and data processing systems that contextualize AI telemetry and evaluation results, helping customers understand application behavior and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Help shape the technical roadmap and architecture for AI Observability and Evaluation, building on Chronosphere’s rapidly scaling platform
  • Collaborate with product managers, deeply technical teammates, and customers to scope, validate, and deliver integrated features and developer workflows
  • Improve our own system observability (we use our own product heavily)
  • Improve the performance, reliability, and cost efficiency of the distributed systems powering AI Observability and Evaluation
  • Mentor engineers and help maintain our engineering standards

You have

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering
  • Strong experience in one or more backend languages (e.g., Go, Java, Python, Rust)
  • Some experience developing LLM powered product features is desirable
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, Codex, Claude) as part of day-to-day software development
  • Experience building and operating highly available systems in production
  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience designing APIs (REST, gRPC, GraphQL) for scale
  • Experience working effectively with cross functional partners
  • Experience owning and executing projects from inception to delivery
  • Experience working with a high degree of autonomy with good judgement on when to push forward and when to ask for help
  • An effective collaborative working style and willingness to build and maintain a positive and supportive environment
  • An ability to operate effectively in a remote first environment

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at .

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship?: Yes

Join the Discovery family, where quality and service are at the heart of everything we do!

This role will be a remote role with regular travel to project sites.

Discovery Land Company is seeking a full time, year round Director, Architecture to join the Creative Services Department.

Job Summary:

The Director, Architecture serves as the lead architectural voice of Discovery Creative across assigned luxury residential, private club, and mixed use developments, from acquisition through delivery. Reporting to the Executive Director, Head of Discovery Creative, the Director engages at the earliest stages of a project, guides architectural direction with project teams and outside architects, and advises executive leadership on design decisions at critical milestones. The Director protects design intent, character, and sense of place, and is accountable for the quality and consistency of architecture across the Discovery portfolio. In this role, you will be part of creating the Discovery Land Company experience for our members and fellow employees.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Early-Stage Strategy and Concept

    • Participate in acquisition and underwriting to align programming, vision, and business assumptions.
    • Develop land plan concepts, high level architectural concepts, test fits, and programming studies.
    • Establish architectural direction early, including massing, character, materiality, and the relationship of buildings to site.

  • Design Direction and Review

    • Guide architectural design for clubhouses, amenity and golf buildings, residences, and mixed use components.
    • Lead architectural peer reviews through the Discovery Creative review process, providing clear and timely feedback at key milestones.
    • Verify that design intent is carried through each phase of design and development.
    • Participate in Discovery Creative team review sessions and consolidate comments for project leads.

  • Team Formation

    • Advise on the selection of design architects, architects of record, and project design leadership; recommend selections to the Executive Director.
    • Draft scopes and RFPs, evaluate fee proposals, and support negotiation of agreements with development and legal.

  • Standards and Creative Infrastructure

    • Develop and maintain architectural principles, standards, and guidelines within the Discovery Creative Library.
    • Promote consistency across the portfolio while encouraging innovation and evolution.

  • Cross-Functional Integration

    • Partner with Development, Sales and Marketing, Operations, and Construction teams to balance aesthetic excellence with operational and financial performance.
    • Support amenity programming, sales center design, and launch strategy.
    • Contribute to value engineering decisions that preserve creative integrity.
    • Support projects through zoning, planning, architectural, and community design review.
    • Work with branding and marketing agencies and the sales team on the design story across collateral, digital, and broker materials.
    • Coordinate with the Discovery Creative interiors, landscape, golf, land planning, and procurement leads.

  • Leadership

    • Present design recommendations to the Executive Director, development leaders, and project partners, and support the Executive Director in presentations to executive leadership and investors.
    • Manage and develop design staff and help build the internal architecture team as the portfolio grows.
    • Capture lessons learned and contribute to repeatable standards.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 10+ years in architecture on luxury projects, including 4+ years on the owner, developer, or advisory side.
  • Experience on private club, resort residential, hospitality, or master planned projects, including horizontal development.
  • Experience directing and critiquing the work of internationally recognized architects and design teams.
  • Strong conceptual design skills, including massing, test fits, and sketching.
  • Understanding of club operations, front and back of house, and how they shape design and programming.
  • Solid understanding of how design drives pricing, absorption, and buyer experience.
  • Working knowledge of construction, cost management, zoning, and offering plan requirements.
  • Exceptional taste with commercial discipline.
  • Strong presenter and communicator with internal leadership, consultants, and brand partners.
  • Degree in architecture, interior design, or a related field; licensure a plus.
  • Ability to travel regularly.

Additional Requirements:

  • Flexibility and ability to pivot to new projects and desire to work in a dynamic, fast moving environment.
  • Positive attitude, professional demeanor, and exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to deliver service to members, guests, and team members.
  • Ability to work in a team environment.
  • Ability to stay calm and focused during the busiest of times.
  • Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English; additional languages preferred.
  • Must be able to work flexible work hours/schedule including evenings, weekends, and holidays. Long hours may be required due to business demands.
  • Ability to meet the physical demands of the position including, but not limited to, working indoors and outdoors in all weather conditions, standing, walking, and moving for periods of greater than eight (8) hours, and lifting and carrying items sometimes greater than fifty (50) pounds.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
  • 401k Contribution
  • Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
  • Employee Meals, Referral Incentives, and Recognition Programs
  • Professional development and upward mobility opportunities
  • Work–Family Culture

Discovery Land Company's good faith estimate of the salary range it reasonably expects to pay for this position upon hire is $175,000 - $198,000 plus bonus.

About Us

Discovery Land Company is a U.S. based real estate developer and operator of private residential communities with a world renowned portfolio of domestic and international properties. The mission of Discovery Land Company is to create one of a kind environments that provide individuals and families the freedom, security, and resources to learn, grow, and play in some of the most beautiful places in the world. data.title: Senior Machine Learning and Java Engineer
data.description:
ABOUT US

At DataEQ, we turn unstructured customer and public feedback into powerful, actionable insights! By combining cutting-edge AI with our unique human data labelling platform, we help some of South Africa’s top companies—like major banks, retailers, and insurers improve customer experiences, manage risk, and streamline digital services. Our innovative solutions make a real difference in industries that matter.

When you join DataEQ, you become part of a dynamic and diverse team of over 50 talented professionals, including data enthusiasts, analysts, and problem-solvers. We believe in fostering a collaborative and supportive environment where creativity and fresh ideas are encouraged. With our clients ranging from leading banks to major retail brands, your work here will directly impact businesses and customers alike.

If you’re passionate about data, excited by the prospect of solving complex challenges, and eager to grow in a fun, fast-paced environment, DataEQ is the perfect place for you. Join us in shaping the future of customer insights while building meaningful relationships with both clients and colleagues!

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a senior machine learning and java engineer to join our development team. You'll work on building and improving our AI systems that process and analyse real-time data streams from various sources including social media, traditional media, and customer feedback channels.

The role involves developing and maintaining machine learning models that work alongside our crowdsourcing platform to provide intelligent data analysis and insights to our clients. You'll be working with real-time data processing, building scalable ML solutions, and implementing efficient data storage and retrieval systems. These are mostly simple classification tasks.

Our tech stack includes:

  • Java and Spring Boot for backend services (this is our main software stack, and you will be doing non-ML work)
  • PostgreSQL for data storage
  • Modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue.js)
  • Python for some portions of our ML stack

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Strong experience in machine learning and AI systems
  • Solid backend development experience with Java
  • Someone who can run tests and maintain code
  • Experience with LLM prompting
  • Experience delivering projects from idea to production
  • A curious, always learning personality
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams
  • Problem-solving skills and proactive attitude
  • Regarding AI and ML: we are looking for a domain expert but not a domain owner. Other members of our team will be working on ML and ML-adjacent projects, and you yourself will sometimes be working on non-ML projects.

We have a culture that encourages curiosity, innovation and freedom, but calls for intellect, emotional intelligence, and performance.

This is an incredibly exciting time to be joining DataEQ as we build out our unique data capabilities in SA and abroad.

Those with unusual career paths or career changes are encouraged to apply — if you believe your skills can help us accelerate our global growth, we want to hear from you.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US

If you join our team, DataEQ will support you at work and at play. We have a dynamic and inclusive company culture and we hire people who put their smarts and hearts into everything they do. We are a fully remote company where you will have the flexibility to manage your own time because we focus on outcomes over inputs. Whilst our team is located around the world, the bulk of our team is based in Johannesburg and Cape Town, South Africa. Should you be located in one of these cities and you enjoy interpersonal connection, we do offer various opportunities to interact in-person.

Our Jozi and Cape Town colleagues can enjoy our “Together Tuesdays” where we get together in a coworking space to enjoy the social engagement a few of us need. We also have monthly drinks to encourage less task-oriented discussions and more connection.

In addition to our flexible and remote working culture which we LOVE, we have many more reasons why you should join our team:

  • A collaborative and nurturing company environment
  • Generous annual leave
  • Regular company status meetings to ensure everyone is aligned and working towards the same purpose
  • Long-term service compensation after 5 years and 10 years
  • Fully remote work environment with access to co-working space
  • A birthday lie-in
  • A solid work from home setup, which includes a contribution towards your WIFI expenses
  • Compulsory Pension Fund and Group Life
  • Optional Medical Aid
  • Personal development budget
  • Regular team socials

NOTE TO APPLICANTS

We appreciate every application we receive and try to give each due consideration. We do receive many though, so please be patient in hearing back from us, and consider that your application has been unsuccessful should you not hear back from us within 14 days of applying. To help us respond faster, please read the requirements carefully and ensure your application contains the details we need. Incomplete applications won't be considered.

data.description:
Ready to Make a Real Impact? Join e-STORAGE!

Who We Are

Welcome to e-STORAGE, a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. (NASDAQ: CSIQ) family! We’re leading the way in designing, building, and integrating advanced battery energy storage systems for utility-scale projects. Our mission? To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone.

With our innovative SolBank lithium-iron phosphate battery technology and comprehensive project services, we’re not just building products we’re powering communities and making a difference worldwide.

Role: Senior BESS Inverter Performance Engineer

Location: Canada or USA

Compensation: $100,000 - $140,000 annual salary + bonus

Role Overview for Senior BESS Inverter Performance Engineer

This role is responsible for diagnosing inverter-related performance issues across operating BESS projects and driving corrective action with inverter vendors. The candidate must be able to identify whether issues are caused by inverter software, firmware, controls logic, hardware, design limitations, or site-level power system conditions. The role also owns retrofit execution tracking, including affected assets, deployment status, validation results, risks, and closure using Excel, Smartsheet, or similar tools.

What You’ll Be Doing as a Senior Performance Controls Engineer

  • Prioritize, investigate, and drive corrective actions for inverter-related performance issues across operating BESS projects.
  • Perform root cause analysis using operational data, first principles, site evidence, and technical review to distinguish software, firmware, controls, hardware, design, and power system issues.
  • Maintain vendor issue logs covering status, root cause, corrective action, validation, and closure.
  • Review vendor release notes, firmware updates, design changes, and retrofit proposals for technical adequacy and operational risk.
  • Work with inverter vendors to define corrective actions, retrofit requirements, implementation plans, validation criteria, and deployment schedules.
  • Support troubleshooting of voltage, frequency, real power, and reactive power distribution issues where inverter behaviour interacts with site or grid conditions.
  • Track retrofit rollouts across sites using Excel, Smartsheet, or similar tools, including affected assets, owner assignments, deployment status, validation evidence, risks, and closure criteria.
  • Ensure all activities are performed in compliance with safety protocols, engineering standards, and company policies.

What You’ll Bring to the Position

  • Engineering degree in electrical, computer, or mechanical engineering with a minimum of five years of experience in renewable energy and/or battery energy storage.
  • Strong knowledge of inverter operation, dispatch control, firmware/software behaviour, controls logic, and hardware design considerations.
  • Power systems knowledge is preferred, including voltage control, frequency response, and real/reactive power behaviour in grid-connected systems.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical issues in parallel with strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  • Experience troubleshooting inverter or BESS performance issues using operational data and event logs.
  • Experience managing corrective action or retrofit rollouts across multiple sites, including status tracking, schedule management, stakeholder follow-up, and closure reporting.
  • Proficiency with Excel, Smartsheet, or similar tools for issue logs, retrofit trackers, deployment dashboards, and action follow-up.
  • Knowledge and experience with SCADA protocols (i.e. DNP3 and Modbus)
  • Familiarity with industrial communication networks (fiber optics, network switches, TCP/IP, etc.)
  • Clear technical communication with vendors, site teams, engineering, and management.
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of time. Travel may be on short notice

What It’s Like to Work Here

At e-STORAGE, you’re more than just an employee—you’re part of a team that values your ideas, your background, and your unique perspective. We believe that a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s the secret to our success. Here, you’ll find:

  • Integrity: We do what’s right, always.
  • Innovation: We encourage fresh thinking and bold ideas.
  • Quality: We take pride in delivering excellence, every time.
  • Customer Focus: We listen, we care, and we deliver.
  • Sustainability: We’re passionate about protecting our planet for future generations.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Join a global leader in renewable energy, backed by over 23 years of Canadian Solar experience.
  • Work on projects that matter—helping to build a cleaner, greener world.
  • Thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your growth is our priority.
  • Enjoy a competitive salary and a generous benefits package.

Want to join here is what we are looking For

  • The right mix of education, experience, and skills for the role.
  • Great communication, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.
  • A true commitment to safety, ethics, and sustainability.

Your Rewards

We offer a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package—including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and more.

Our Commitment to Equality & Diversity

“At e-STORAGE, we know that diverse teams drive innovation and better results. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered—regardless of age, race, gender, ability, or background. When you join us, you’re joining a community that celebrates your uniqueness and supports your success.”

— Libby, Sr. Global HR Manager

Above Group Overview

We offer you the opportunity to put your passion and your God given talents and abilities to use. For more information, see www.abovegroupinc.com.

Our People Strategy

We believe in a people strategy to be the fundamental driver of our organization.

While we can never reach a perfect organizational model, we can certainly strive towards it in our daily efforts and mission. With that vision comes a focus of key initiatives we are working on, listed here, with the indicators of what it should look like as we approach:

Shared Direction: A collective understanding of what the organization stands for, where it is going, and how we will get there. Indicators: a clear inspiring vision, well-executed strategies, clear aligned goals.

Authentic Values: Deeply held principles guiding all decisions and relationships and reflected in the conduct of everyone at all times. Indicators: high levels of trust and communications, uncompromising integrity and ethics, socially responsible practices.

Productive Relationships: Open, collaborative relationships that recognize and honor the commitments that people make to themselves, each other, their work, and the organization. Indicators: respect for all individuals, effective problem solving and decision-making, clear accountability, effective teamwork at all levels.

Liberating Processes: Flexible structures, processes, and technologies that allow people to do their best work and to collaborate effectively across boundaries. Indicators: clear organizational design, collective knowledge, the right tools and technologies, the right people for the right jobs.

Outcome Learning: Results-focused learning that strengthens individual and organizational capacity to cope with the present and define the future. Indicators: continuous teaching and learning, effective knowledge and skills development, leadership development at all levels.

Motivating Metrics: Fair, meaningful performance requirements, measure and rewards that reinforce high performance and manage poor performance. Indicators: clear and energizing performance requirements, relevant work measures, differentiated rewards.

Our Vision – What We Want to Do

Continuously improving the built environment for the glory of God.

Our Mission – Why We Exist

Demonstrating the love of Jesus Christ through empowering excellent AEC professionals to provide superior service.

Electrical Designer (ED)

The Electrical Designer for Above Group shall contribute and support the Power, Lighting, Grounding, Lightning Protection, Fire Alarm, and Systems or Low Voltage Engineering efforts for the firm. The ED shall directly contribute to the Firm and its success through drafting and design efforts. This individual shall directly contribute to the Firm and its success through technical experience to effectively produce a quality design and ultimate product to the customer. The ED shall execute drafting and design duties as required to ensure quality is always maintained.

GPU Software Engineer (CUDA)– Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: GPU Software Engineer (CUDA)
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$175,000 Annually
Experience Required: 10+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a GPU Software Engineer with deep expertise in CUDA programming, GPU architecture, and high-performance computing to design and optimize compute-intensive workloads on modern accelerator hardware. This role focuses on extracting maximum performance from GPU platforms for AI training, inference, scientific computing, and high-throughput data processing workloads. The ideal candidate combines low-level systems mastery with strong software engineering practices, and has a track record of delivering measurable performance improvements on production GPU systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement high-performance CUDA kernels for compute-intensive workloads across AI and HPC use cases.
  • Profile and optimize GPU code using tools such as Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, and CUDA profilers.
  • Tune memory access patterns, occupancy, register usage, and shared memory utilization for peak performance.
  • Develop highly optimized libraries for linear algebra, attention, and other ML primitives.
  • Optimize multi-GPU and multi-node training using NCCL, RDMA, and high-performance networking.
  • Implement custom operators and fused kernels in PyTorch, JAX, or Triton.
  • Collaborate with ML engineers to identify performance bottlenecks in training and inference pipelines.
  • Develop benchmarks and regression tests to safeguard performance over time.
  • Evaluate new GPU architectures and feature sets, and advise on adoption strategy.
  • Contribute to compiler-level optimizations for tensor programs where appropriate, working at the boundary between ML frameworks and underlying accelerator codegen to unlock performance not reachable through framework-level tuning alone.
  • Optimize memory hierarchy usage across HBM, L2, shared memory, and registers.
  • Implement mixed-precision and quantized compute paths that maximize accelerator throughput while preserving numerical fidelity within bounds acceptable for the target workloads.
  • Document performance characteristics, design decisions, and tuning playbooks for internal teams.
  • Stay current with GPU architecture, CUDA evolution, and emerging accelerator technologies.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Ten or more years of experience in GPU programming and performance engineering.
  • Deep expertise in CUDA C/C++ and GPU programming models.
  • Strong understanding of modern GPU architectures, memory hierarchies, and execution models.
  • Hands-on experience profiling and optimizing GPU workloads in production.
  • Familiarity with NCCL, MPI, and high-performance interconnect technologies.
  • Experience integrating custom kernels into ML frameworks.
  • Strong C++ skills and familiarity with modern systems programming practices.
  • Solid grounding in linear algebra and numerical methods.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with research and engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or other GPU kernel authoring frameworks.
  • Familiarity with TensorRT, FasterTransformer, or vLLM internals.
  • Exposure to compiler infrastructure such as LLVM or MLIR.
  • Open-source contributions to GPU or ML performance libraries.
  • Experience with large-scale distributed training infrastructure.

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

data.description:
Staff Platform Engineer - Earthly Lunar

Write production software, design the cloud architecture behind it, and own how it runs in the real world.

About Earthly Lunar

Earthly Lunar is a guardrails engine for the AI era. Engineering organizations use it to turn their standards for quality, security, and compliance into automated checks across their repositories and CI/CD pipelines. Teams get feedback directly in pull requests, leaders can see where standards aren't being met, and compliance evidence is collected as the work happens. The standards apply whether a developer or an AI agent writes the code.

We're a small, AI-native team backed by Innovation Endeavors and Work-Bench, with angels including Jeff Dean, the CEOs of Datadog, Cockroach Labs, and Dash0, the founder of Sentry, and the creators of Elixir, Pandas, and Ruff/uv. We're building for enterprise engineering teams with complex environments and high expectations for reliability.

The role

We're looking for someone who is an excellent software engineer and an excellent cloud engineer. You can design and build a substantial backend feature in Go, work through the architecture it needs, deploy it safely, and debug it when production behaves differently from the test environment.

You'll work on Lunar's core product and the infrastructure that runs it, across our hosted service and customer-managed deployments. That includes backend services, deployment automation, Kubernetes, and the operational work that makes enterprise software dependable.

This is a staff-level individual contributor role. You'll stay hands-on while helping decide what we build, making architectural calls, and leading substantial projects through to production. We want someone whose judgment improves the whole team's work, not just their own code.

What you'll do

  • Write and maintain production Go code in Lunar's backend and supporting services. Own features from design and testing through deployment and ongoing operation.

  • Design and evolve our AWS architecture and Kubernetes infrastructure. Make deliberate trade-offs around reliability, security, performance, cost, and how much complexity a small team can support.

  • Build reusable Terraform modules, Helm charts, and deployment tooling. Make provisioning, upgrades, and recovery repeatable for both our hosted service and customer-managed installations.

  • Improve production reliability: useful metrics and alerts, capacity planning, backups and tested recovery, safe rollouts, and clear rollback paths. Participate in incident response and fix the causes of recurring problems.

  • Debug across the stack. Follow a failure through Go code, a database query, container behavior, Kubernetes networking, or cloud infrastructure rather than stopping at a team boundary.

  • Improve CI/CD and the development environment so engineers can test realistic changes and ship frequently without making production fragile.

  • Work with our forward deployed engineers and customer platform teams on difficult deployment and scale problems. Turn what we learn into product improvements that help every customer.

  • Lead technical design and code reviews, mentor teammates, and document decisions well enough that other engineers can maintain what you build. Keep solutions proportionate to the problem.

  • Build and manage AI-assisted engineering workflows for implementation, review, testing, and operational investigation. Make useful workflows repeatable for the team, with appropriate access controls and checks on their output.

What we're looking for

You need substantial software engineering experience and deep production infrastructure experience, plus extensive use of AI in your engineering work.

  • Strong Go and software engineering fundamentals. You've designed, shipped, and maintained production services, not only infrastructure scripts. You're comfortable with concurrency, APIs, testing, performance work, and debugging distributed systems.

  • Deep AWS experience. You've made and lived with cloud architecture decisions involving networking, IAM, compute, storage, and managed databases. You understand failure modes, isolation boundaries, and cost.

  • Extensive Kubernetes experience. You've built and operated production clusters and workloads, handled upgrades, and debugged real failures. You understand scheduling, networking, storage, RBAC, resource management, and Helm beyond following an installation guide.

  • Extensive Terraform experience. You've designed reusable modules and managed production infrastructure through code, including state, environment separation, drift, and safe changes to existing resources.

  • Strong operational instincts. You're comfortable with Linux, Docker, networking, and troubleshooting under pressure. You've taken responsibility for systems after launch and made them easier to operate over time.

  • Experience with production data and observability systems. You can operate and troubleshoot PostgreSQL or comparable SQL databases, object storage such as S3, and metrics, logs, and traces using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.

  • Extensive experience using and managing AI workflows. AI coding tools and agents are part of your daily work. You build your own workflows, supply the context and tools they need, and manage their permissions, cost, and failure modes. You can explain how you verify generated code and infrastructure changes, and you remain responsible for the result.

  • A staff-level track record. You've taken ambiguous problems, chosen a practical approach, brought other engineers along, and delivered substantial changes that held up in production.

  • Clear communication and high ownership. You write useful design notes, can explain a trade-off to another engineer or a customer, and make progress without waiting for a detailed specification. You know when to ask for help.

Nice to have

  • Experience building developer tools, infrastructure products, or other B2B software used by engineering teams.

  • Experience shipping software into customer-managed Kubernetes environments, including restricted networks and enterprise security requirements.

  • Experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers, queues and background workers, or distributed job execution.

  • Experience with GitOps and progressive delivery, Kubernetes operators, or multi-region systems.

  • Familiarity with software supply-chain security, policy as code, or compliance automation.

  • Experience as an early startup engineer or founder.

You might not be a fit if

  • You want an architecture or management role with little hands-on coding.

  • You enjoy operating infrastructure but don't want to build substantial production software, or want to write features without owning how they run.

  • You use AI only occasionally and aren't interested in building and managing your own engineering workflows.

  • You need a narrowly defined remit and a separate team to handle every issue outside it.

How we work

  • We're a small, senior team. You'll work directly with the founder and the founding engineers, with room to shape both the product and how we build it.

  • We use AI heavily and invest in the tools that make the team effective. Engineering judgment, testing, and review still matter.

  • We favor frequent, tested releases and straightforward systems over elaborate architecture we don't yet need.

  • Production ownership is shared engineering work. Part of your job is to make it less dependent on any one person.

  • We're remote, with overlapping working hours and written communication that lets people work independently.

Compensation & logistics

  • Base salary: $210,000-$260,000 (US base), depending on experience, plus equity.

  • Location: Remote (US & Canada).

  • Type: Full-time, staff-level individual contributor.

  • Production support: Incident response is part of the role.

Benefits

  • Healthcare, dental, and vision, including dependents (US & Canada)

  • Incentive stock plan

  • 401(k) / RRSP with employer matching (US & Canada)

  • Life insurance (US & Canada)

  • Credits for gym or activity equipment (US & Canada)

  • Fully remote work

  • Direct ownership of substantial engineering work in an early-stage company

Salary: 210K - 260K USD a year

data.description:
AI Solutions Architect / Copilot Developer

Human-centered problem-solving meets Microsoft AI technology

Role Overview

We're looking for someone who thinks like a strategist, debates like a philosopher, and builds like an engineer. This role sits inside our AI Solutions Group, where the individual will need to reason clearly about ambiguous problems, build consensus among stakeholders, and translate that thinking into working solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform.

You'll partner directly with clients to figure out where AI can provide tangible improvements, gather and interpret requirements (even when clients aren't sure what they need), build solutions using Power Platform tools, help test and validate what you've built, and keep it optimized over time. This role is about people, logic, and persuasion as much as it is about implementation.

Why This Role Is Different

We believe the core skills for working effectively with AI aren't primarily technical. They're:

  • Creative problem solving: finding non-obvious paths through ambiguous, messy, or "less than optimal" situations
  • Strategic thinking: seeing the whole system, not just the ticket in front of you
  • Logic and structured reasoning: the same discipline that makes a good philosopher makes a good prompt engineer and a good solution architect
  • Communication and diplomacy: building consensus among stakeholders with competing priorities, teaching non-technical teams, and handholding through change

If you have a background in philosophy, strategy consulting, teaching, mediation, debate, logic, systems thinking, or similar disciplines, and you're excited by AI tools, we want to talk to you, even if your technical resume looks nontraditional.

What You'll Actually Do

With Clients

  • Act as a trusted advisor: ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and help clients articulate problems they haven't fully defined yet
  • Build consensus across stakeholders with different, sometimes conflicting, priorities. This is often the hardest part of the job
  • Teach and support end users through change, including patient handholding for less AI-fluent teams
  • Translate business problems into technical requirements, and technical constraints back into plain language

Building the Solution

  • Design and develop solutions in Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and related Power Platform tools
  • When necessary, integrate adaptive cards, connectors, triggers, and APIs to extend functionality
  • Craft effective prompts and grounding strategies for Copilot, Claude, and related AI tools. This is applied logic and language craft as much as coding
  • Build and prototype using Copilot-related AI tools for development and automation, always within strict data-control guardrails
  • Where possible, apply this same workflow to working with Anthropic’s Claude

Keeping It Working

  • Participate in testing, validation, and quality assurance
  • Support ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and enhancement of deployed solutions
  • Document decisions and create user guides that make adoption easier, not harder
  • Escalate and resolve issues, mentoring teammates along the way

Staying Sharp

  • Continuously evaluate new AI tools and platforms, with a healthy respect for compliance, governance, and data protection in a regulated environment
  • Bring an "AI mindset": curious, experimental, but never careless with sensitive data

What We're Looking For

Core (non-negotiable) skills:

  • Strong critical thinking and structured reasoning: you can break down a fuzzy problem into a clear plan
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to and persuade skeptical or non-technical audiences
  • Diplomacy and consensus-building, with comfort navigating disagreement without avoiding it
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and a track record of picking up new tools quickly

data.title: Senior Android Engineer
data.description:
About Medium

Medium is one of the world's most influential writing platforms, connecting millions of readers with ideas that matter. We're a small, dedicated team that cares deeply and takes real ownership of the problems we tackle, moving fast while building something that lasts. Our actions and decision-making are guided by four principles: Humans First, Deepen Understanding, Orient for Impact, and Ladder Together.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer to help build and evolve the Android experience that millions of readers and writers rely on every day. You'll own Android features end to end. That means digging into what users actually need, building it, shipping it, and paying attention to how it actually performs once it's out in the world. You'll work closely with our design team the whole way through.

This is a product engineering role at heart. We don't have a dedicated product team, so you won't be handed a fully-specified ticket and told to go build it. Rather, you'll be the one figuring out what's worth building in the first place, partnering with design and other engineers, and making good calls when the ask is vague or doesn't quite solve the real problem. Android is where you'll spend most of your time, but we want someone who can also hold their own on at least one other platform, whether that's web, iOS, or backend. That range matters: it means you can see how a feature fits into the bigger picture, make good calls about where logic should live, and work credibly with whoever owns that other platform.

What You'll Do

  • Own Android features end to end. Understand the problem, build it, ship it, and see how it actually does
  • Shape what gets built, not just how it gets built. Push back on scope, propose simpler solutions, and raise platform constraints early rather than after the fact
  • Write idiomatic, well-tested Kotlin and Compose UI that fits naturally into the team's existing architecture
  • Work directly with iOS, web, or backend engineers depending on what a feature needs, and help decide where functionality should live
  • Partner with our leadership team, design team, and engineers in the US and France to turn a rough idea into something that actually ships well on Android
  • Bring superb judgment to ambiguous requests. You can ask good questions, spot edge cases early, and propose reasonable first steps when the full scope isn't clear yet
  • Own shaping product and feature spaces, maintaining and driving a sense of forward momentum even when the final destination of your work may not be clear
  • Help raise the bar for the mobile team on code quality, testing, and product thinking
  • Attend Medium's twice-yearly, in-person offsites (hosted in locations around the U.S.)

What You Have

  • You've spent several years building production Android apps and you're genuinely fluent in Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, coroutines and Flow, and modern Android architecture
  • You're an expert with all things Android engineering, but you can also hold your own on at least one other platform (web, iOS, or backend) and can work credibly there when a feature calls for it
  • You think like a product engineer. You don't just build what's asked, but can own and appreciate the impact at a product impact altitude of your work.You understand the problem underneath the request, push back when something doesn't add up, and care about whether it actually worked once it shipped
  • You've worked closely with designers and engineers on other platforms before. You're good at explaining a technical tradeoff in a way that actually lands for someone who isn't an engineer
  • You have good instincts about systems, you're adaptable, and you're genuinely eager to learn. You can advocate for an approach while staying open to a better one. We care a lot about collaboration and psychological safety here. We want someone who adds to it
  • You have the ability to push forward in ambiguity and make great trade off decisions to keep a project moving

Nice to Haves

  • Experience using AI to improve a team's leverage, reach, output and impact
  • You've owned product direction yourself rather than just executing someone else's plan
  • You personally use Medium and are genuinely excited to contribute to its mission, which is empowering humans to write meaningfully for other humans

Benefits

In addition to the new skills you'll pick up, here's what else you'll enjoy by working at Medium:

  • Working with a fully distributed team: We’re fully remote and have teammates across the U.S. & France
  • Healthcare benefits covered at 100% for employees and 80% for dependents
  • Generous parental leave policy
  • Mental health support through Spring Health (or find a provider through Rula or Kaiser Mental Health Network)
  • Financial wellness support through Northstar
  • Stipends for co-working, professional development, wifi, and a one-time home office bonus
  • Unlimited PTO and standard company holidays
  • A discounted Medium membership

Why Medium

We're a small team doing meaningful work. Beyond guiding your team's execution, you'll have real influence over engineering strategy, culture, and direction. You'll work alongside people who are genuinely good at what they do and who care about building something worth building.

At Medium, inclusion, diversity, and equity are core to how we work and what we build. We believe a more inclusive team creates a better product—one that’s intuitive, thoughtful, and serves a wide range of users. We strive to foster a supportive, fun, and challenging environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive.

We welcome applicants from all walks of life and strongly encourage those from historically underrepresented groups to apply. Our hiring process is built to ensure fairness and equal opportunity for everyone. Even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you—your perspective and passion matter more than checking every box.

Learn more about our mission, operating principles, and culture:

  • Yes to a diverse community
  • Be part of a better internet
  • Medium Rules
  • Operating Principles

Read about our story here.

Read our guidance on AI use for candidates. We believe human ideas have the power to change how people think, for the better. That belief shapes how we hire. We use AI tools ourselves, but we’ve thought carefully about where it adds value and where it gets in the way of something important.

Salary Range

$165,000—$215,000 USD

GDPR Notice

We will process your personal data as part of our recruitment process, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). For details on how we use your data, including the legal bases for processing, how long we retain it, and your rights under GDPR, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

We may retain your information for future job opportunities based on our legitimate interest in building a talent pool. You can object to this at any time by contacting us at recruiting@medium.com.

CCPA Notice

If you are a California resident, you have rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA). These include the right to know what personal information we collect about you, the right to request deletion or correction of your data, and the right to opt out of certain uses.

During the hiring process, we may collect personal information such as your name, contact details, resume/CV, employment history, education background, and any information gathered through interviews or assessments. We may share this information with service providers who support our recruitment process, in compliance with CCPA/CPRA. This information is used solely for recruitment and hiring purposes.

We do not sell or share your personal information as defined under CCPA/CPRA. Candidate data is retained for up to 48 months for our legitimate business purposes and in accordance with applicable laws.

To exercise your rights or request more information, please contact us at recruiting@medium.com. This notice can also be found on our Privacy Notice.

At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

Our Platform:

Our mobile apps are Swift and Kotlin. Our frontend is built with React. Our backend uses Elixir and increasingly more and more Python. GenAI has significantly impacted our system architecture, requiring us to adapt and evolve. We are in the midst of a shift from existing products augmented with AI to a full AI-first platform.

You Are:

A Mobile Principal Software Engineer who will lead our mobile team and evolve it to meet the shifting demand of a full AI-first platform — on a timeline measured in weeks, not quarters. You're deeply hands-on with AI coding agents, and you've used them to ship serious work, not just autocomplete. You're as comfortable architecting a thin mobile client backed by a powerful API as you are dropping into our Python backend (with AI assist) to add what mobile needs. You'll shape our participant experience across mobile with heavy influence on the web too.

You're deeply product focused, energized by solving business problems, not just writing code. You ask "why" before "how," and you partner with Product and Design as a peer — shaping problems, not just taking specs. You know when to ship a scrappy prototype to test an assumption versus when to invest in a foundation built to last, and you can explain that call to a PM or designer. You can hold multiple projects in your head at once, spotting where they'll collide, depend on each other, or share a chance for reuse.

You bring Principal/Staff-level scope as a product engineer — 10+ years of experience evolving apps and standing up new ones across product and technical dimensions. You have a proven track record of leading technical improvements and mentoring other developers, as collaboration and empathy are cornerstones of our culture. You thrive setting your own direction with minimal input while staying aligned to company goals.

Most of all, you're energized by the prospect of doing in months what used to take years. If this sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you.

The Job

Working hours

Availability 9:30 AM - 5:00 PM CT

  • Dscout is a US-based company, and while working these core hours is expected in this role, we know that from time-to-time life happens and we can be flexible to meet your needs.

What you will do:

  • Lead our mobile team and its continued maturity and evolution in this AI-native space
  • Stand up an AI-native development process for the mobile team — agents, evals, review loops — that sustains that pace beyond the rewrite
  • Drive a thin-client architecture for the participant experience, pushing business logic to the backend so the apps stay simple
  • Contribute Python to our AI backend service when mobile needs new capabilities — using AI agents to do it efficiently
  • Set our participant API and broader participant platform direction beyond the mobile team
  • Spend about 70% of your time supporting your product team; the other 30% on self-directed leadership tasks and platform improvements
  • Drive continuous process improvement across the mobile team and its partner teams
  • Mentor other engineers and help evolve the Engineering org
  • Apply a DevOps mindset to improve the Continuous Delivery pipeline and other operational aspects of our SaaS & mobile platform
  • Be involved in security and compliance efforts for the organization (we are SOC II & HITRUST certified)

What you need to have:

  • Significant experience as a mobile software engineer with Principal/Staff-level scope (titles aren’t important — we care about what you’ve shipped and led)
  • Experience with iOS and Android, and a willingness to work outside the mobile ecosystem when the problem calls for it
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) — not just autocomplete — and an opinion on how to design an SDLC around them
  • Experience in system architecture to supplement mobile experience (backend API design, databases, mobile devops), how it all fits together, and design trade-offs
  • A proven track record of leading, mentoring, and growing engineers
  • Expertise with cloud-based SaaS architectures and evolutionary design
  • At home with agile, DevOps, CI/CD, observability/tracing, and data/metrics-based decision making

Of course, what is outlined above is an ideal set of expectations; however, business needs and other projects and tasks may shift, and additional tasks could be assigned at the discretion of your manager.

About Dscout

Dscout is a team of passionate, empathetic, and curious professionals. As a recognized leader in the Forrester Wave, we’re at the cutting edge of experience research technology. The power of research drives us - how in-context insights from real people can build more enjoyable products and services.

We prioritize learning, sharing, and building. We also deeply value being a diverse and inclusive team and company and look for team members who align with that belief. Join our dynamic team and help shape product roadmaps and business strategies for the world’s most loved brands.

It doesn't stop there. When you join the Dscout team, you will get:

At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

Role Overview

Signifyd uses the latest in AI and machine learning technology to give our ecommerce customers the confidence they need to do business free from fears of fraud and other forms of ecommerce abuse. In order to do this we have to continually innovate and nowhere is this more important than in our modeling space. The modeling group creates, deploys and runs the models and services that keep us a step ahead and right now we need an engineering manager to help us build our next generation technology. The successful candidate will lead a team of engineers who will partner with our AI group and engineering as a whole to help bring ideas from conception to production, while ensuring the systems we already have continue to run smoothly. It’s a role for someone who can operate comfortably on both sides of the technical/business line, contributing to technical discussions but people-focused enough to build the relationships between engineering, our AI lab, product and our risk management organization.

You will work daily with data scientists, machine learning engineers, product owners and other cross-functional stakeholders whose work depends on your team's systems. Success means being a trusted translator and partner across all of these groups, not just a manager of your own team's output.

Your core responsibilities are delivery, fostering innovation and people leadership. How hands-on you get as part of that is up to you but you will be expected to drive closure on technical decisions and implementation.

Key Responsibilities (outcome and accountability)

1. Team Leadership & Growth

  • Manage, coach and grow a team of engineers, providing regular feedback, career development while ensuring performance remains high.
  • Build a healthy team culture with clear ownership, sustainable pace and high standards for quality and craftsmanship.
  • Recruit and onboard new engineers as needed and develop technical leadership within the team.

2. Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Manage competing priorities and expectations across multiple stakeholder groups, building trust through fostering mutual understanding, delivering consistently and communicating transparently.
  • Represent the team's roadmap, capacity and risks in cross-functional planning and prioritization discussions.

3. Technical Engagement & Decision-Making

  • Drive technical discussions and design reviews, with enough depth to understand the implications of key decisions on reliability, scalability and production outcomes.
  • Partner with engineers on architecture and design choices, asking the right questions rather than dictating solutions.
  • Ensure the team's technical decisions are well understood by, and defensible to, other stakeholders.

4. AI-Enabled Ways of Working

  • Model and champion effective use of AI tools across the team's day-to-day work, including AI-assisted research, administrative workflows, and code generation.
  • Help the team develop good judgment about how to balance the productivity gains AI can bring against the risks it introduces.
  • Continuously look for ways AI tooling can improve team efficiency, code quality, and decision-making, and share what's working with peers.
  • Manage effectively through the major changes AI is bringing to the industry.

5. Delivery & Operational Rigor

  • Own delivery of the team's roadmap balancing feature work, technical debt and reliability commitments.
  • Establish and maintain appropriate quality, testing and monitoring practices.
  • Provide clear, proactive communication on progress, risks and blockers to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Define metrics as needed and develop an understanding of why we did or didn’t hit our targets.

Qualifications & Skills (experience / depth)

Experience

  • 5+ years working as a software engineer. Some of that experience should be in the ML sphere.
  • This should not be your first time managing and we’d prefer at least 4 years of experience managing engineers directly in an ML focused domain.

Technical & AI Fluency

  • Comfortable engaging in technical discussions on architecture, data flows, and system design.
  • Demonstrable experience using AI tools in a professional capacity for research, administration and code generation with a clear point of view on how to use them responsibly and cost-effectively.
  • Strong knowledge of software development best practices, cloud computing platforms, big data technologies, MLOps toolkits, and SLO-driven reliability management.
  • Experience working with at least one of Databricks, Spark, Airflow, Vertex and the GCP technology stack in general is preferred.

Stakeholder Management & Communication

  • Strong track record managing relationships with a diverse set of technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate clearly across audiences and influence without authority.
  • Comfortable navigating competing priorities and pushing back constructively when needed.

Leadership

  • Genuine care for engineer growth and development, with experience giving structured feedback and building career paths.
  • Ability to build trust and psychological safety within the team while holding a high bar for output and accountability.

data.description:
MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers, including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders.

In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions, the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours.

Le rôle

We are looking for several software development managers to lead one of our engineering teams. As a development manager at MaintainX, you are the person who turns a roadmap into reliable, shipped software. You will manage 5 to 6 developers, be responsible for delivery and quality within your team's area, and make the decisions that let a group of builders move forward without losing sight of the business.

This is a single hiring process for our product and platform teams. Among the teams currently looking for a new leader:

  • Reporting: You would be responsible for the product interface where customers measure the value of MaintainX, turning millions of work orders and asset events into dashboards and analytics that maintenance leaders present to their executives. This is a highly visible team with a direct link between what you ship and why customers renew.

  • Identity & Access Management: Build the systems that provide secure, seamless access to the entire MaintainX platform. You will design and operate authentication, authorization and governance services that scale with our enterprise customers, while delivering a frictionless and reliable user experience.

  • Search: Design and build MaintainX's end-to-end search and retrieval platform. You will work on indexing, ranking and query understanding so that technicians and managers can find the right asset, the right procedure or the right work order in seconds.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Manage a team of 5 to 6 developers: be responsible for their delivery, quality and daily priorities.

  • Collaborate with product managers and designers to define scope, plan and deliver to a high reliability standard.

  • Coach and grow your developers: help them build their skills, overcome complex problems and plan their next career step.

  • Shape tomorrow's team. All of these teams are hiring and need a leader who will conduct interviews and raise our talent bar.

  • Set clear expectations and provide ongoing feedback so your team always knows where it stands.

  • Promote continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), code quality and observability practices in your team's systems.

  • Give senior leadership visibility into your team's impact, progress and risks.

Où nous travaillons

We do not impose a minimum office presence, but we prefer that our teams be located near our hubs. In Canada, these are Montreal and Toronto.

Ce que nous recherchons

  • 2 to 3 years of people leadership experience, with a track record of teams that deliver.

  • A strong technical foundation. You must be comfortable working at a senior level in system design, computer science fundamentals and modern web technologies.

  • Experience in technical design, problem solving and project management (experience with Jira preferred).

  • A genuine interest in recruiting, coaching and developing engineers, not just directing them.

  • Comfort collaborating with the recruiting team and other managers to hire and grow the organization.

  • Excellent communication skills: you know how to discuss trade-offs with an engineer as well as with a non-technical stakeholder.

Our mission is to keep the physical world running. Factories, fleets, hospitals and campuses stay up because the people who maintain them have tools worth using. That is what we build.

Compensation and benefits. Base pay is one part of the package. Depending on the role, compensation may also include commission, an annual bonus and equity. Benefits differ by country. For roles in the United States, Autodesk’s benefits are described at benefits.autodesk.com. For roles in Canada and other countries, the plan differs on health coverage, retirement and leave, and your recruiter will walk you through it.

Belonging. We take pride in a culture where everyone can thrive. More at autodesk.com/company/global-belonging. More on where this is going: Autodesk CEO Andrew Anagnost on building the future of connected operations, and AOS SVP Stephen Hooper on welcoming MaintainX to Autodesk.

Apply directly on RemoteJobs.org: https://remotejobs.org/remote-jobs/gestionnaire-de-dveloppement-logiciel-maintainx
