data.title: Senior Network Engineer
data.description:
Leidos is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to support Federal Civil customer in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.

LOCATION: This position is remote; however, prefer candidates that are within driving distance to the Washington, DC area.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Senior Network Engineer will serve as a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, implementing, optimizing, and sustaining complex network solutions spanning on-premises infrastructure and hybrid cloud environments. The position requires technical expertise, independent problem-solving, and the ability to develop effective solutions to complex network challenges involving multiple technologies and technical disciplines. The successful candidate will collaborate with customer stakeholders, engineering teams, cybersecurity professionals, and program leadership to maintain network availability, performance, and security while supporting infrastructure modernization and evolving mission requirements. This role also provides technical guidance to other engineers and contributes to network architecture, engineering standards, and continuous operational improvement.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must have or able to obtain a Public Trust clearance; Must be a US Citizen.

PRIMARY RESPONSBILITIES:

  • Serve as a Senior technical and escalation resource for complex network engineering and operational issues affecting mission-critical enterprise infrastructure.
  • Lead the planning, design, implementation, and optimization of complex network infrastructure solutions across geographically distributed, multi-vendor environments.
  • Independently analyze complex technical challenges involving multiple systems and disciplines, develop engineering solutions, and implement corrective actions that improve network reliability, performance, and security.
  • Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise routing and switching infrastructure, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, routing redundancy, and network failover.
  • Engineer and support enterprise network security solutions, including Cisco Firepower, Firepower Management Center (FMC), ASA, firewall policies, access controls, and security hardening.
  • Design, implement, and sustain secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN solutions, including Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect and connectivity with external partners and vendors.
  • Engineer and maintain hybrid cloud network connectivity integrating on-premises infrastructure with AWS networking services, including VPCs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and load balancing.
  • Support enterprise wireless networking and network access control technologies, including Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
  • Lead technical planning and execution of network infrastructure upgrades, modernization initiatives, lifecycle replacements, and security remediation activities.
  • Evaluate network performance, availability, capacity, and emerging technical requirements; recommend and implement improvements to strengthen service delivery and operational resilience.
  • Lead complex incident investigations and root cause analysis, identifying systemic issues and developing sustainable corrective and preventive solutions.
  • Collaborate with customer representatives, program leadership, cybersecurity teams, vendors, and service providers to assess requirements, develop technical solutions, and influence network engineering decisions.
  • Develop and maintain network architecture documentation, configuration standards, technical implementation plans, and operational procedures.
  • Support incident, problem, change, and service request management processes while ensuring technical accuracy, documentation, and operational accountability.
  • Provide technical mentorship, peer review, and engineering guidance to junior and mid-level network engineers.
  • Identify opportunities for network automation, standardization, and process improvement to increase operational efficiency, reliability, and security.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field with 8+ years of relevant network engineering experience; additional education and experience equivalencies may be considered.
  • Advanced hands-on experience designing, implementing, administering, and troubleshooting complex enterprise network infrastructure in production environments.
  • Expert-level knowledge of enterprise routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and network redundancy and failover.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and implementing technical solutions to complex network problems involving multiple systems, technologies, or engineering disciplines.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise network security infrastructure, including firewalls, access control policies, and VPN connectivity.

data.description:
Greater Good Charities is a 501(c)(3) global nonprofit organization that works to help people, pets, and the planet by mobilizing in response to need and amplifying the good. To date, we have provided over $1B in aid, expertise, and funding in 121 countries in support of this mission.

Position Overview:

The Director of Supply Chain is a high-impact, hands-on operational leader and strategic troubleshooter. Operating at the intersection of supply chain execution, data analytics, and program strategy, this role is built to drive rapid operational optimization across GGC's global distribution engine.

You will lead the end-to-end movement of donated (in-kind) and procured goods, balancing immediate operational pragmatism with long-term systems modernization. Embedded within a data-driven programmatic architecture that prioritizes evidence for decision-making, you will design agile inventory frameworks, establish demand forecasting, and enforce supply chain best practices tailored for non-governmental organizations.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Agile Inventory Management & Demand Planning

  • Design, implement, and maintain responsive demand planning models that seamlessly bridge internal program planning and donor pipelines with global suppliers, downstream partner capacities, and community needs.
  • Establish agile inventory control protocols to ensure real-time visibility, optimize stock rotation, minimize warehousing overhead, and mitigate product expiration risks.
  • Structure and manage a pre-positioned Disaster Response Reserve, ensuring rapid deployment capability during acute emergency responses without disrupting ongoing core distribution.

2. End-to-End Supply Chain Execution (70% US / 30% International)

  • Direct the full operational lifecycle of goods: donor offer matching, multi-modal freight contracting (TL, LTL, Ocean, Air), field receiving, inventory verification, distribution, and financial closeout.
  • US Domestic Logistics (70%): Oversee recipient partner networks and warehouse operations, establishing industry best practices for safety, pest control, receiving, capacity planning, and field training.
  • European & International Operations (30%): Direct cross-border logistics, import/export requirements, and customs compliance for international shipments, ensuring specialized frameworks like the EU Goods program meet regional standards.
  • European Capacity Expansion Strategy: Develop and execute a strategic capacity growth plan to absorb, manage, and scale corporate and in-kind donations across Europe through a robust, sustainable supply chain framework.
  • Own carrier and broker relationships, negotiating competitive rates, monitoring SLAs, and managing detention, damage, and freight claims.

3. Systems Integration, Data Architecture & Decision Intelligence

  • Serve as the operational business owner for GGC’s logistics tech stack (Salesforce, NetSuite ERP, Smartsheet, SharePoint, and WMS), maximizing system efficiency and tool interconnectivity to deliver streamlined procedures, reduced cycle times, and accurate financial reporting.
  • Eliminate manual data re-keying by standardizing data intake forms, partner reporting portals, and digital field submissions, leveraging lightweight, right-sized AI-powered solutions to automate document processing and field data capture.
  • Transform raw supply chain and field data into actionable intelligence, building real-time executive dashboards tracking key operational metrics (e.g., report timeliness, cycle times, accept/decline rates, pledged vs. received accuracy, and net landed impact).

4. Process Troubleshooting & Pragmatic SOP Optimization

  • Act as a pragmatic troubleshooter across the supply chain, identifying bottlenecks, resolving operational friction, and bridging gaps between field realities and formal policy.
  • Develop, consolidate, and enforce unified Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for movement tracking, inventory control, and bill of lading (BOL) submission pathways.
  • Balance practical field solutions with necessary system upgrades, ensuring new workflows remain user-friendly for field partners while adhering to strict institutional controls.

5. Financial Reconciliation & Compliance Governance

  • Partner with Finance to ensure 100% alignment between physical inventory movement, field receipt documentation, and the general ledger.
  • Streamline the financial closeout and reconciliation cycle time for in-kind shipments and handling fee invoices.
  • Maintain IRS-ready documentation (Form 990 / Form 8282 standards), enforce strict no-resale policies, manage recall protocols, and support internal and external financial/programmatic audits.
  • Ensure compliance with U.S. export control and sanctions regulations (EAR/OFAC) for international shipments, including denied-party screening of partners, vendors, and recipients.

6. Partner Capacity Building

  • Establish performance criteria, quality scorecards, and audit frameworks for domestic and international distribution partners, implementing systematic approaches to collect, analyze, and act upon audit findings.
  • Create user-friendly onboarding toolkits, digital training modules, and technical support pathways for field teams, program focal points, and community distribution networks.
  • Recommend corrective action protocols (probation, suspension, or offboarding) when partner compliance or safety standards are compromised.

7. Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build, mentor, and direct the global logistics team, establishing a clear staffing model and career progression pathways.
  • Serve as a collaborative team player and primary operational liaison between Logistics, Programs, Finance, Operations, and Corporate Relations, translating complex supply chain data into strategic recommendations for C-Suite leadership.

Minimum Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field required (Master’s degree a plus).
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership in global supply chain and logistics management.
  • Professional certification such as APICS/ASCM CSCP or CPIM, ISM CPSM, or Certified Humanitarian Logistician (CHL) strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record as a hands-on "troubleshooter" capable of making swift, practical decisions in fast-paced NGO or humanitarian environments.
  • Strong team-building skills with a highly collaborative approach to cross-departmental work.
  • Demonstrated experience with ERPs (NetSuite), CRMs (Salesforce), and WMS platforms.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Proven ability to bridge everyday operational tools (e.g., spreadsheets, Smartsheet) by embedding them into enterprise systems and AI-assisted workflows to boost efficiency and user adoption.
  • Expertise in US freight and warehousing networks (70%), combined with practical knowledge of international cross-border logistics, customs, and international trade compliance (30%).
  • Solid understanding of inventory valuation, audit readiness, financial reconciliation, and managing donor-restricted goods.
  • High initiative and strategic thinking, with the ability to balance immediate operational field demands with long-term organizational transformation.
  • Commitment to the mission of Greater Good Charities.

Working Environment:

This position is fully remote. The employee is expected to work 40 hours per week from 9 am – 5 pm in their time zone, Monday – Friday. Travel: 30% (includes domestic & international)

Benefits:

Benefits include 13 paid national holidays, sick leave, paid vacation, parental leave, 401K, life insurance, medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Salary: $94,000-126,000

data.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of view
  • Expert Python and SQL

NICE TO HAVES

  • Real ad budget spent in live auctions
  • Large-scale ranking or recommendation systems
  • Explaining tradeoffs to non-technical partners in plain terms
  • Designing for auction feedback loops, selection bias and exploration
  • Hands-on neural network work, such as embeddings of text, creative or user behavior
  • AWS for data science: ECS, S3, Athena, SageMaker
  • CI/CD deployment

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

Since day one, we've been committed to having a diverse, inclusive team and culture. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity company. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company Flipp, creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands. We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR

We’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Data Analytics team.

In this role, you’ll act as a key partner for Product, Data, and Business teams, leading measurement strategies and analytical initiatives to uncover insights that drive strategic and operational decisions.

You’ll work cross-functionally to transform complex data into clear narratives that demonstrate the value of our products and guide smarter business choices.
If you thrive on solving complex analytical problems, enjoy turning data into impactful stories, and love collaborating across teams, this role is for you!

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to identify business questions and translate them into analytical solutions.
  • Translate product requirements into clear data requirements, ensuring data and analytics solutions align with business objectives and product goals.
  • Develop measurement strategies, frameworks, and KPIs to evaluate product and business performance.
  • Design and build dashboards and analytical tools to monitor key initiatives and enable data-driven decision-making.
  • Conduct impact analyses and A/B tests to validate hypotheses and optimize outcomes.
  • Deliver compelling data stories through reports, visualizations, and presentations.
  • Demonstrate the value of Flipp’s products and channels through performance tracking and insight storytelling.
  • Coach and support analysts, fostering best practices in analytical thinking and communication.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Lead.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong SQL skills and working knowledge of Python or R for data analysis.
  • Advanced knowledge of data visualization and BI tools (e.g. ThoughtSpot, Looker, Power BI, or Tableau).
  • Familiarity with modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or similar).
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. LLMs, prompt engineering) to automate and improve analytical workflows.
  • Strong data acumen and the ability to grasp complex data concepts, enabling effective collaboration with technical teams on analytics infrastructure and data pipelines.
  • Solid understanding of statistics and experimentation methodologies.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into business narratives.
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and influence decisions through insights.
  • A growth mindset and passion for continuous learning.

At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

LOCATION

While we have an office in Milan, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid model (full-remote available from Italy), empowering you to work where you're most effective. Shopfully and Flipp, a leading Canadian company, are part of the same group: you’ll be hired in Europe while working directly within Flipp’s organization, in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Since you’ll be collaborating with colleagues across different time zones, a bit of schedule flexibility will help you stay connected with our amazing teams in Canada!

If you’re excited about joining a dynamic, international team, working on cutting-edge projects and expanding your career globally, we’d love to hear from you!

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY

An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices

WHO WE ARE

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

TO FEEL AT HOME ️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED

  • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
  • Clarity Through Transparency: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.
  • Learn Loudly: We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.
  • Challenge with Empathy: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.
  • Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

data.title: Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance

experience_requirements.text: 7+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, and data management within the fintech, crypto, financial services, or gambling industry, gained in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We're looking for a Sr. Data Analyst, Compliance to join our team remotely! The primary goal of this role is to elevate decision-making by uncovering emerging trends and root causes, and by driving insights and actions that provide full visibility into business performance and operational efficiency.

Beyond technical expertise, success in this role depends on being a true business partner who combines data-driven insights with strategic thinking to deliver actionable recommendations, guide decision-making, and drive measurable impact across the organization.

In this role, you'll own end-to-end data management, from building and maintaining datasets and pipelines to designing dashboards and delivering insights for the Compliance team. A core part of this role is owning the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals. You'll also contribute to experimentation infrastructure, laying the groundwork for future ML and intelligence initiatives.

The opportunity

  • Own the logic and rule-setting behind transaction monitoring across deposits and withdrawals, partnering closely with Compliance to study patterns and refine detection logic

  • Translate compliance requirements into production detection logic, preserving correctness across alert eligibility, thresholds, customer segmentation, date windows, and deduplication

  • Develop and maintain Python and SQL pipelines for transaction data preparation, feature engineering, and detection workflows

  • Evaluate detection rules and analytical models across coverage, alert quality, threshold sensitivity, and the impact of proposed changes

  • Design reproducible evaluations on historical data that account for limited labels, class imbalance, and shifts in customer behaviour over time

  • Own testing, deployment, scheduling, monitoring, and operational support for detection workflows, including investigating data quality issues, pipeline failures, and unexpected changes in detection results

  • Execute historical backfills with clear validation and traceability, and maintain reliable downstream alert delivery and integrations with compliance systems

  • Be at the forefront of data innovation by experimenting, testing hypotheses, and translating insights into action, while incorporating software engineering best practices into pipelines and dashboards.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, and data management within the fintech, crypto, financial services, or gambling industry, gained in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

  • Experience working with compliance, fraud, funding, finance, and customer support teams and analyzing large datasets, engineering features, and applying statistical methods to practical business problems

  • Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience building and supporting production data or analytical systems

  • Hands-on experience using dbt or similar tooling to model and organize high-fidelity data for reporting and decision-making

  • Experience setting up and managing data pipelines with a strong understanding of workflow orchestration, plus strong software engineering practices including version control, automated testing, code review, and CI/CD

  • Solid statistical foundation; ML exposure is a strong plus

  • Proficiency with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Hex, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) to build executive-facing dashboards

  • Ability to investigate production issues independently and communicate technical findings and uncertainty to non-technical stakeholders

  • You believe wholeheartedly in the values outlined in Kraken's Tentaclements document

  • A degree in a field emphasizing analytical rigor, such as analytics, software engineering, statistics, or economics

  • Based in Canada, the US, or Brazil, and fluent in English

Nice to haves

  • Fraud detection, AML, anomaly detection, or other risk applications

  • Experience with Athena, Trino, Kafka, and Kubernetes alongside the core Airflow/dbt/S3 stack

  • Transaction pattern analysis, customer segmentation, and detection threshold tuning

  • Developing or productionising machine learning models, including experiment tracking and performance monitoring

  • Working with sparse or delayed feedback from investigations to evaluate and improve detection

  • Explainability, auditability, and change control in regulated environments

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

data.title: Real-Time Data Engineer
data.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Real-Time Data Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $135,000–$160,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced Real-time Data Engineer to architect, deploy, and operate large-scale Apache Kafka and Confluent platform environments supporting mission-critical event-driven workloads. In this role you will own the Kafka platform end-to-end, including cluster sizing, configuration, security, automation, observability, and developer enablement. The ideal candidate will combine deep Kafka internals knowledge with strong DevOps and SRE practices, and will partner with application teams to deliver a reliable, performant, and developer-friendly streaming platform. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of experience operating Apache Kafka or Confluent Platform in production.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Kafka internals (partitions, replication, ISRs, consumer groups).
  • Strong experience with Kafka security (SASL, mTLS, ACLs, RBAC).
  • Hands-on experience with Kafka Connect, Schema Registry, and either Kafka Streams or ksqlDB.
  • Experience with HA/DR strategies for Kafka.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Go.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Working knowledge of observability tooling for Kafka.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Confluent Certified Administrator or Developer credentials.
  • Experience operating Kafka on Kubernetes (Strimzi, Confluent Operator).
  • Exposure to managed Kafka services (AWS MSK, Azure Event Hubs Kafka API).
  • Familiarity with stream processing frameworks (Flink, Spark Streaming).
  • Experience with data governance and lineage for streaming data.


How to Apply

Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908)676-4399. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

data.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Staff Technical Program Manager, Advanced Technology Group

Pinterest Technical Program Managers deliver critical and strategic outcomes by directing and scaling engineering effort across organizational and functional boundaries.

Pinterest is looking for a highly technical, experienced Staff TPM to join the Advanced Technology Group (ATG), a research-driven engineering organization advancing Pinterest's ML/AI capabilities. You'll partner directly with senior product and engineering leaders to turn ambitious AI strategy into shipped, reliable, and widely adopted capabilities. This is a high-visibility role spanning research, ML platform, infrastructure, safety, and product teams.

What you'll do:

  • Lead complex, multi-workstream programs across ML research, platform engineering, infrastructure, safety/compliance, and product, aligned under one roadmap, metrics, and governance.
  • Partner closely with the VPs of Product and Engineering to translate strategy into workstreams, staffing, milestones, and clear decision-making.
  • Drive the path from research to production: model development, evaluation, release management, serving capacity, and adoption by product teams.
  • Define and track metrics and guardrails (quality, cost, reliability, adoption, cycle time) and use them to drive decisions.
  • Run technical design and decision forums; identify risks and tradeoffs early and align senior leaders on a path forward.
  • Build operating mechanisms (planning, reviews, intake, launch readiness, post-mortems) that scale across teams working at different paces.
  • Use AI tooling to automate tracking, reporting, and program insights.
  • Communicate status, risks, and decisions to executives and cross-functional partners, tailoring technical depth to the audience.

What we're looking for:

  • Minimum 8 years in technical program management, engineering, or related roles, with a track record of leading org-level, multi-team ML/AI or platform programs.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep technical understanding of ML/AI systems (training and post-training, evaluation, model serving, GPU capacity, release management) and platform engineering. You can read design docs and challenge assumptions.
  • Experience with LLM/multimodal model adoption, such as adapting open-source models, evaluation frameworks, and migrating workloads between model providers, is a strong plus.
  • Proven ability to partner with VP and Director-level leaders in Product and Engineering and influence strategy and prioritization.
  • Experience designing planning processes and governance (annual and multi-half planning) across several organizations.
  • Strong analytical skills: SQL, dashboards, and using data from experiments and evaluations to drive decisions.
  • Comfort with high ambiguity, rapidly changing technology, and cross-functional work with Legal, Privacy, and Safety partners.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including nuanced technical concepts for executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale processes, and to use AI tools to automate program management.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

  • We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

Relocation Statement:

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

Headquarters: Remote Poland

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization.
As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement. 
You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure.

data.description:
About Invisible

Invisible Technologies makes AI work. Our end-to-end AI platform structures messy data, automates digital workflows, deploys agentic solutions, measures outcomes, and integrates human expertise where it matters most.

Our platform cleans, labels, and structures company data so it is ready for AI. It adapts models to each business and adds human expertise when needed, the same approach we have used to improve models for more than 80% of the world’s top AI companies, including Microsoft, AWS, and Cohere.

Our successes span industries, from supply chain automation for Swiss Gear to AI-enabled naval simulations with SAIC, and validating NBA draft picks for the Charlotte Hornets.

Profitable for more than half a decade, Invisible reached $134M in revenue and ranked as the number two fastest growing AI company on the 2024 Inc. 5000. In September 2025, we raised $100M in growth capital to accelerate our mission of making AI actually work in the enterprise and to advance our platform technology.

About the Role

We're looking for a Director of Engineering to set the technical strategy for Data Labs, the team that builds the benchmarking systems, data pipelines, and RL environments behind our AI training engagements. The frontier labs and enterprises we work with are changing how they train, evaluate, and deploy models every quarter. Your job is to see where that market is going and make sure Data Labs is built for it before our clients ask.

You'll decide which capabilities we invest in, which we standardize into platform, and which we leave to individual engagements. You'll track how training methods, evaluation practices, and data needs are shifting across the industry, and turn that into a technical roadmap and a point of view our commercial and research teams can sell against.

You'll lead a group of engineering managers, forward deployed engineers (FDEs), and senior ICs, and partner closely with applied research, product, and go-to-market leadership. This is a hands-on strategic role. You won't spend much time writing code, but you'll stay close enough to the technical work to make and defend hard architectural calls, and close enough to clients to know which calls matter.

What You'll Do

Technical Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the multi-year technical strategy for Data Labs, and translate it into a roadmap tied to where the AI training and evaluation market is heading.
  • Decide where to build shared platform versus engagement-specific solutions, weighing reuse against team autonomy so platforms speed teams up rather than creating over-dependency.
  • Set architectural direction for benchmarking infrastructure, data pipelines, and RL environments so they stay reproducible, portable across client deployments, and ready for the next generation of training methods.
  • Anticipate technical shifts 6–18 months out, such as new post-training techniques, agentic evaluation, and synthetic data, and place the bets that keep Invisible ahead of them.
  • Set expectations for how AI is used in design reviews and day-to-day engineering work.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Positioning

  • Build a clear, current view of how frontier labs and enterprises are training, evaluating, and deploying models, and what that means for the data and infrastructure they'll need from us.
  • Track the competitive landscape across AI data, evaluation, and RL environment providers, and help define where Invisible differentiates.
  • Turn client signals, research developments, and market trends into investment recommendations for executive leadership.
  • Partner with product and commercial teams to shape new offerings, pricing logic, and the technical story behind them.

Evaluation & Data Strategy

  • Define Invisible's point of view on benchmarking and evaluation, including pre- and post-engagement comparisons, capability gap analyses, and regression tracking.
  • Make sure evaluation design ties to client-defined success metrics, validate automated checks against human judgment, and be explicit about what each approach can't see.
  • Identify reusable data assets, frameworks, and pipelines that become durable advantages and improve margins across engagements.
  • Shape practices for data licensing, privacy, and contamination risk as a strategic differentiator, not just a compliance requirement.

Client & Executive Engagement

  • Represent engineering in executive conversations, strategic client relationships, and pre-sales, translating technical reality into clear, honest narratives.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to client research and engineering leaders, bringing back what you learn to inform the roadmap.
  • Help leaders weigh client-specific asks against broader platform and business goals, with clear short- and long-term paths.

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead and grow an engineering org of multiple teams, including engineering managers, senior managers, FDEs, and Staff+ ICs.
  • Coach managers to build sound technical judgment and strategic awareness in their teams.
  • Build hiring pipelines that reinforce a rigorous, client-focused, strategy-aware engineering culture.
  • Make sure the org has the planning, quality, and operational practices it needs to execute on the strategy reliably, delegating day-to-day delivery to strong managers.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with significant experience building ML or AI systems.
  • 5+ years in engineering leadership, including experience managing managers across multiple teams.
  • A track record of setting multi-year technical strategy and making platform investment decisions that paid off commercially.
  • Deep, current understanding of the AI training and evaluation landscape, including how frontier labs and enterprises approach fine-tuning, RLHF/RLAIF, and evaluation methodology.
  • Hands-on familiarity with LLM training pipelines, deep enough to make and defend architectural decisions.
  • Experience building benchmarking, data curation, or RL infrastructure that produced measurable client outcomes.
  • Ability to read market and competitive signals and turn them into a technical roadmap and a clear product point of view.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership with applied research, product, and commercial teams.
  • Excellent executive communication, and confidence acting as a technical advisor in client and pre-sales conversations.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience at an AI services firm, applied research consultancy, frontier lab, or enterprise AI product company.
  • A visible point of view on the AI data and evaluation market, such as talks, writing, or open-source work.
  • Familiarity with data licensing, synthetic data generation, or contamination detection involving client data.
  • Experience shaping new product lines or service offerings from a technical foundation.
  • Experience leading an org through rapid growth or significant change.

What’s In It For You

Invisible is committed to fair and competitive pay, ensuring that compensation reflects both market conditions and the value each team member brings. Our salary structure accounts for regional differences in cost of living while maintaining internal equity.

For this position, the annual salary will include a 20% annual bonus and an additional incentive structure. The base salary range for SF/NY are:

Salary Range

$252,000—$300,000 USD

You can find more information about our geographic pay tiers here. During the interview process, your Invisible Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm which tier applies to your location. For candidates outside the U.S., compensation is adjusted to reflect local market conditions and cost of living.

*Bonuses and equity are included in all full-time offers. Final compensation is determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, internal pay equity, and overall market conditions. Because of this, every offer is unique. Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

What It's Like to Work at Invisible:

At Invisible, we’re not just redefining work—we’re reinventing it. We operate at the intersection of advanced AI and human ingenuity, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to unlock productivity and scale. Ownership is at the core of everything we do. Here, you won’t just execute tasks—you’ll build, innovate, and shape the future alongside world-class clients pushing the boundaries of AI.

We expect bold ideas, relentless drive, and the ability to turn ambiguity into opportunity. The pace is fast, the challenges are big, and the growth is unmatched. We’re not for everyone, and we’re okay with that. If you’re looking for predictable routines, this isn’t the place for you. But if you’re driven to create, thrive in dynamic environments, and want a front-row seat to the AI revolution, you’ll fit right in.

While some roles may offer remote flexibility, most positions involve in-office collaboration and are tied to specific locations. Any location-based requirements or hybrid expectations will be communicated by our Talent Acquisition team during the recruiting process.

Who We Are

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $22.7 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

The Opportunity 

As a Sr. Data Engineer at Oportun, you will be a key member of our team, responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining sophisticated software / data platforms in achieving the charter of the engineering group. Your mastery of a technical domain enables you to take up business problems and solve them with a technical solution. With your depth of expertise and leadership abilities, you will actively contribute to architectural decisions, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, scalable software solutions that advance our impact in the market. This is a role where you will have the opportunity to take up responsibility in leading the technology effort – from technical requirements gathering to final successful delivery of the product - for large initiatives (cross-functional and multi-month-long projects).

At Oportun, we move fast and we hold each other to a high bar. If you care about doing your best work while actually moving the needle for real people, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day

  • You’ll design and implement scalable, efficient, and reliable data architectures that support business and analytical needs.
  • You’ll build and maintain data pipelines, ETL processes, and integration solutions for large volumes of structured and unstructured data.
  • You’ll optimize data pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes for performance, reliability, scalability, and security.
  • You’ll partner with stakeholders to understand data requirements, develop domain expertise, and translate business needs into effective data models and solutions.
  • You’ll establish and improve data quality standards, validation rules, documentation, and governance practices.

  • You’ll help evolve engineering tools, platforms, and practices and encourage adoption of better ways of working.
  • You’ll look for practical ways to use AI tools to improve engineering productivity, analysis, documentation, and problem-solving.

Who You Are

The right fit looks like this

You’re a hands-on data engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and building systems that others depend on. You combine strong technical depth with a practical understanding of business needs and know how to turn ambiguous requirements into scalable solutions.

You take ownership, communicate clearly, and are comfortable leading technical work without relying on formal authority. You enjoy mentoring others and helping teams make stronger technical decisions.

What You Bring

Skills & experience

Required

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Databricks experience or certification.
  • Experience with AWS Redshift, S3, Azure SQL Data Warehouse, or comparable cloud data services.
  • Experience implementing data governance, data quality, or observability frameworks.
  • Experience leading cross-functional or multi-month engineering initiatives.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, troubleshooting, documentation, or productivity.

Our AI Mindset

We build with AI. We lead with judgment.

AI isn't a feature here. It's how we work.

We're excited about what AI makes possible, and we're looking for people who share that curiosity. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be open to experimenting, willing to learn, and able to apply new tools in ways that actually move the needle.

In this role, you'll be encouraged to explore AI tools, find practical use cases for your function, and bring ideas for working smarter. We believe the best outcomes come when human judgment and AI capability work together.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.

  • Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.

  • Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).

  • Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.

  • Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.

  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.

  • Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.

  • Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.

  • Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.

Bonus

  • Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.

  • Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.

  • Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.

  • Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).

  • Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw.

data.title: Data Scientist - Computer Vision
data.description:
ABOUT US

ARRISE sets the benchmark for service delivery and excellence in the iGaming industry. Playing a key role in the success of its clients, which include Pragmatic Play, a brand relied upon by the world’s biggest online casinos for its cutting-edge products, ARRISE helps to deliver exceptional gaming experiences to millions of players worldwide.

Our global team of over 13,000 talented and driven professionals are shaping the future of iGaming. Headquartered in Gibraltar, we have offices spanning Canada, India, the Isle of Man, Latvia, Malta, Romania, Serbia, Bulgaria, and the UAE, and more exciting destinations on the horizon.

At ARRISE, we take pride in creating growth opportunities at all levels, constantly investing in our people while welcoming new colleagues and forging strategic partnerships that open new opportunities for success.

To achieve this, we bet on ourselves. We know that success is a collective effort, and our team is driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared commitment to grow and succeed — while embracing every step of the journey.

Be part of the future of iGaming with 13,000 ARRISERS! See a job that excites you? Apply now, and our friendly recruitment team will connect with you soon. Your journey starts here.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will join our Data Science team as a Data Scientist working at the applied-research end of computer vision. You will frame open-ended problems as testable hypotheses, develop prototypes to validate them, and choose the model architectures and methods best suited to each. Computer vision is the core domain, with scope to work across text, audio, and tabular data. Working with ML Engineers, you will help take validated prototypes into production and see them run at scale.

Even if you don't meet every requirement, your skills and ability to deliver impact are what matter most.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Design and prototype ML and deep learning models, with computer vision as the primary domain (object detection, classification, tracking).
  • Frame business problems as testable hypotheses and develop proofs-of-concept to validate them, iterating on the results.
  • Evaluate and benchmark competing model architectures and pre-trained models to identify the best-fit approach.
  • Collaborate with ML Engineers to scale validated prototypes into production systems and stay engaged through deployment.
  • Track experiments, manage model and data versioning, and define evaluation metrics to compare approaches objectively.
  • Work with product, engineering, and business teams to turn objectives into applied ML solutions.

WHAT WE ASK OF YOU

  • Master's degree in a relevant field such as Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline.
  • Hands-on experience developing ML and deep learning models, including demonstrated computer vision work.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and a deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
  • Experience with computer vision models for object detection, image classification, and tracking.
  • Solid grounding in deep learning, traditional computer vision, and classical ML.
  • Strong experimentation mindset: benchmarking, ablation studies, and structured evaluation of competing approaches.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets.

Nice to have

  • Experience collaborating with ML Engineers to bring models into production.
  • Experience with any major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP) for ML training and deployment.
  • Familiarity with Docker and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Hugging Face Transformers, vision transformers, or self-supervised / representation learning.
  • Exposure to generative AI: prompt engineering, RAG, LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack), or LLM fine-tuning.
  • Background in gaming, iGaming, e-commerce, or other consumer-facing applications at scale.

How we work

Our stack includes Python with PyTorch and TensorFlow, experiment tracking and model versioning, containerized deployment with Docker, and CI/CD pipelines. Data Scientists and ML Engineers work together across the full lifecycle, from early research through to models running in production.

WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE

  • Work on substantial, real-world computer vision and deep learning problems at scale.
  • End-to-end involvement, from research and prototyping through to production.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development.
  • A collaborative, cross-functional environment with visible impact.

  • Experience using Amazon OpenSearch Service, graph databases, or graph-processing frameworks for relationship mapping, link analysis, and suspicious-network detection.
  • Experience developing explainable AI solutions, including confidence scoring, reason codes, feature attribution, evidence traceability, and analyst-friendly explanations.

  • Knowledge of AWS security and governance practices, including IAM, encryption, logging, data classification, least-privilege access, and handling sensitive or regulated information.

data.title: EverHealth - Sales Insights Analyst (Remote, US)
data.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here:

EverHealth, a business within EverCommerce, provides modern end-to-end solutions for healthcare providers. Our open, connected ecosystem of solutions and services helps providers engage patients, increase revenue, improve business efficiency, and remain market competitive. We serve 72,000 healthcare practices and counting. EverHealth consists of five SaaS products; DrChrono, iSalus, CollaborateMD, Updox, and MDTec, combined these products offer end to end solutions for the health care industry.

The Pre-Sales Insights Analyst is a key member of EverHealth's Revenue Analytics & Insights team, responsible for owning analytics across the pre-sales funnel from lead through closed-won. Reporting to the Revenue Analytics & Insights Manager, this role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to improve funnel performance, pipeline quality, and go-to-market decision-making.

Supporting four EverHealth product lines (DrChrono, CMD, Updox, and iSalus), the analyst will build scalable reporting and insights around funnel conversion, ICP segmentation, win/loss analysis, and pipeline health. This role transforms fragmented sales data into actionable insights that help leadership identify the best customer segments, improve conversion rates, increase forecast accuracy, and optimize GTM strategy.

Responsibilities

  • Own the analytical view of the pre-sale funnel from lead through closed-won.
  • Build and maintain funnel conversion reporting (Lead → MQL → SAL → SQL → Closed-Won).
  • Identify conversion gaps by product, segment, channel, and rep cohort.
  • Develop and maintain pipeline quality scoring based on fit, engagement, deal age, and stage velocity.
  • Analyze pipeline velocity and identify stall points.
  • Measure inbound and outbound lead quality by source, channel, and campaign.
  • Analyze SDR conversion rates and identify top-performer patterns.
  • Analyze AE performance, pipeline coverage, velocity, and closed-won rates.
  • Perform closed-lost analysis by stage, reason, segment, and competitor.
  • Build and maintain the Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) framework.
  • Support ICP scoring models and refine lead scoring criteria.
  • Analyze segment performance, win rates, ACV, sales cycle, CAC, and time-to-value.
  • Build cohort analysis across products, segments, channels, and acquisition periods.
  • Support TAM and addressable market analysis using enrichment data.
  • Track ICP deviations and identify off-ICP win/loss trends.
  • Own the win/loss analysis program, including methodology, reporting, and competitive intelligence.
  • Produce recurring win/loss reports and actionable insights for Sales and Product leadership.
  • Support GTM planning with funnel benchmarks, quota attainment, capacity modeling, and productivity analysis.
  • Leverage AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to accelerate analytics, reporting, and build reusable prompt libraries.
  • Build and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards for funnel, pipeline quality, quota attainment, and self-service analytics.

Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:

  • 2+ years in Sales Analytics, Revenue Operations, Business Intelligence, or GTM Analytics with ownership of recurring reporting and analytical deliverables.
  • Strong Salesforce reporting and dashboard experience with knowledge of the SFDC data model and data quality management.
  • Advanced Excel skills (Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, formulas, data modeling).
  • Experience building funnel, conversion, and pipeline analytics, including stage conversion and drop-off analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business questions into actionable insights.
  • Comfortable working with imperfect data and driving continuous improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting insights to business leaders.
  • Experience using AI/LLM tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude) to improve analytics and reporting workflows.

Preferred

  • Experience with ICP analysis, pipeline quality scoring, or win/loss analysis.
  • Knowledge of B2B SaaS metrics including MQL, SQL, ACV, CAC, pipeline coverage, and sales cycle analytics.
  • Healthcare or HealthTech experience.
  • Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or Metabase.
  • SQL proficiency for self-service analysis.
  • Experience with CRM enrichment or sales intelligence tools (Gong, 6sense, Bombora, ZoomInfo, etc.).
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and AI-assisted analytics, including AI agents or workflow automation.

Where:
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States - if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
  • Continued investment in your professional development
  • Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits package, including an annual wellness stipend.
  • 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
  • Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program

Compensation:

The target base compensation for this position is $85,000 to $100,000 USD year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

data.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications will be accepted until 01/31/2027.

About the Role

Our architect team is organized into four domains that together make the platform work for customers: Platform Advantage (why Salesforce, why now), Emerging Tech & UI Innovation (agent execution and dev tooling), Data & AI Excellence (data, semantics, and AI context), and Governance & Trust (identity, security, and audit). This req can land in any of the four, based on where your deepest expertise fits and where the team has the most need at the time of hire.

Across all four domains, the DNA is the same: you lead with the customer's business and technical problem, not a product pitch, you're fluent across Salesforce and its alternatives, and you stay engaged through execution so the work actually lands, not just the recommendation.

What You'll Do

Your day-to-day will concentrate in one or two of the following, depending on domain placement:

  • Agent Architecture (Platform Advantage / Governance & Trust): orchestration, agent-to-agent interaction, state and memory, guardrails, testing.
  • MCP & Capability Architecture (Platform Advantage / Emerging Tech): exposing business capabilities for agents to discover and act on, not just raw objects.
  • Data 360 & Semantic Architecture (Data & AI Excellence): unified customer data, semantic layers, and the context AI needs to be useful.
  • Headless & Composable Architecture (Platform Advantage / Emerging Tech): APIs, headless experiences, and composable extensions of Salesforce beyond the standard UI.
  • AI-Assisted Development (Emerging Tech): coding assistants, reviewing AI-generated work, dev lifecycle and quality practices.
  • AI Governance & Security (Governance & Trust): identity and permissions, data access, agent authority, human-in-the-loop controls, audit.

data.description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

About the role

As Circle expands the customers and payment methods it serves, our fraud exposure grows and changes. We rely on conservative limits and third-party models today, and we are building our own.

As a Senior Data Scientist on Fraud Analytics, you will own the prediction side of our fraud loop. You will turn labels into features and models, measure their accuracy, and shift Circle from vendor scores to in-house models. You will work with Fraud Strategy, Fraud Operations, Risk Engineering, and Compliance.

What you’ll do

  • Build and evaluate fraud models for onboarding, login, account changes, and money movement. Target risks include account takeover, scams, money mules, and stolen and synthetic identity.
  • Evaluate third-party risk signals and design the path from vendor models to Circle models, from shadow mode to production.
  • Define the label taxonomy and data requirements with Fraud Operations and Risk Engineering, so every event, decision, and outcome becomes training data. This includes the fraud we miss.
  • Design holdout and exploration sampling to measure false negatives and the rate at which we wrongly block good customers.
  • Track fraud rate, dispute rate, fraud loss rate, and precision across customer segments. Help set thresholds against an agreed loss budget.
  • Work with Fraud Strategy to tune thresholds and rules and respond to emerging attacks.
  • Backtest, monitor drift, and retrain models on Circle’s fraud platform.
  • Help build AI agent workflows for transaction review, fraud-ring analysis, and rule drafting, and evaluate their accuracy against human labels.

Core Requirements

  • 5+ years in data science or applied ML on fraud, risk, or financial crime
  • Advanced Python and SQL, and experience with XGBoost, LightGBM, or similar
  • Experience building models with sparse, delayed, or biased labels, including cold start, reject inference, and chargeback lag
  • Strong statistics: anomaly detection, graph or network methods, experimentation, and threshold optimization
  • Experience taking models to production and monitoring them
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners
  • Comfort working through ambiguity and limited historical data

Preferred Requirements

  • Fintech, payments, crypto, or card fraud experience, including chargebacks and disputes
  • Experience with device intelligence, behavioral signals, or consortium data
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics, AML, and KYC
  • Experience evaluating LLM or agent-based review workflows
